title: ilionx's vertical mix is unresolved; only its Oracle and Microsoft stack is recorded
content:
ilionx is a Dutch integrator recorded with an Oracle, Microsoft and integration stack, and the assessment leaves its vertical mix unresolved. Of the two, the missing half is the more useful one: the stack says what the bench can do, the verticals say whether the sovereignty and audit arguments would land at all.

So the lead sits at priority 4 behind an open-source screen, while the screen is not actually the binding gap — the vertical mix is. This note records which question is outstanding so the next research pass asks the right one instead of repeating the posture check.

---
